# Mini setup flow

Owner issue form -> authenticated Mini poll -> isolated worker -> Ratatoskr PR -> hosted CI and CodeRabbit -> independent verifier -> Brokkr approval and guarded merge -> private receipt.

The setup paths in this packet are admission-dependent. The live coordinator must verify the current issue, base revision, branch protection, deployment evidence, and private admission record before dispatch. This repository has no rollout proof from this packet; live proof remains pending.
